commands: ENDPOINT=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /moodle/redis/endpoint --region $REGION --query Parameter.Value --output text 2>/dev/null || echo '')
if [ -z "$ENDPOINT" ]; then echo 'No Redis endpoint in SSM'; exit 2; fi
getent hosts "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'DNS lookup failed for endpoint'; exit 3; }
# Restore last good backup if config currently has syntax errors
if ! php -l $CFG >/dev/null 2>&1; then LASTBK=$(ls -1t $CFG.backup.redis.* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || echo ''); if [ -n "$LASTBK" ]; then echo "Restoring $LASTBK"; cp "$LASTBK" "$CFG"; fi; fi
# Update if Redis host already present; otherwise insert full block before require_once using a temp block file

if grep -q '^\s*\$CFG->session_handler_class' $CFG; then sed -i -E "s|^\s*\$CFG->session_handler_class\s*=.*|$CFG->session_handler_class = '\\core\\session\\redis';|" $CFG; else sed -i "/require_once.*lib\/setup.php/i $CFG->session_handler_class = '\\core\\session\\redis';" $CFG; fi
awk 'NR==FNR{blk=blk $0 ORS; next} { if(inserted==0 && $0 ~ /require_once.*lib\/setup.php/){ print blk; inserted=1 } print }' /tmp/redis_block.php $CFG > $CFG.tmp && mv $CFG.tmp $CFG
php -l $CFG || { echo 'PHP syntax error in config.php'; exit 4; }
